name: io.github.elvispaul7/gmat-mx
title: GMAT MX
description: Official GMAT Focus percentiles, GMAC fees for Latin America, exam rules and practice questions

tools.name: score_to_percentile
tools.description: Convert a GMAT Focus Edition total score (205–805) to its official percentile ranking (GMAC, 2021–2026 data).

tools.name: get_gmat_fees
tools.description: GMAT fees in Mexico, Ecuador, Colombia and Peru in USD: registration (test center/online), reschedule and cancellation windows, additional score reports.

tools.name: get_exam_policy
tools.description: GMAT Focus Edition format: sections, questions, minutes, score scale, attempt limits, score validity.

tools.name: get_sample_question
tools.description: One original GMAT-style practice question with answer, explanation and trap analysis. Filter by section (quant, verbal, data) or question type.

id.description: Return a specific question, e.g. q3
